text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day of Vivlos's Make Debut had 
arrived. Upon arriving in Kyoto, where the 
racecourse was located—

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Vivlos~! Do your best!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The moment I stepped off the Shinkansen, a 
huge crowd welcomed me. Among them, some 
people were holding up uchiwa fans with 
Vivlos's name on them.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait, am I getting super popular right 
now?"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh, wow, that's amazing! Even before 
making your debut!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"...Well, I guess that makes sense. I 
mean—"

text_block_list.name: Trendy Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, she really is super cute! She looks 
just like her mother. That Umamusume's—

text_block_list.name: Trendy Fan B
text_block_list.text:
I only became a fan of Verxina later on... 
so I'm rooting for her little sister right 
from the start~!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Mom and big sis are super famous after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I want to become a celebrity like the two 
of them too~♪
choice_data_list:
(Doesn't look like she's feeling the 
pressure)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While the intense spotlight can be a 
burden for some girls... in Vivlos's case, 
there seems to be no need to worry. Just 
then—

text_block_list.name: Verxina's Fan
text_block_list.text:
Vivlos! Congratulations on your debut 
decision!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Thank you~! Are you a fan of my mom or big 
sister too?

text_block_list.name: Verxina's Fan
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ah, I'm a fan of Verxina.

text_block_list.name: Verxina's Fan
text_block_list.text:
Back during Verxina's run, I watched every 
single race live on-site!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ehh~! That's amazing! You really are a 
huge fan!

text_block_list.name: Verxina's Fan
text_block_list.text:
Yes! That's why I want to cheer for her 
younger sister too! Even with Cheval 
Grand, I went to watch her debut race.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Is that so! Then~, will you cheer for me 
just as much as you cheered for Big Sis?

text_block_list.name: Verxina's Fan
text_block_list.text:
Of course! ...No, I'll pour even more 
heart into it than that!

text_block_list.name: Verxina's Fan
text_block_list.text:
So that you can become a wonderful 
Umamusume just like your older sister... 
please let me cheer you on with all my 
heart!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Declaring that she will follow in the 
footsteps of her older sister Verxina will 
naturally raise expectations for the 
Triple Tiara. This is no mere whim; it is 
her genuine, heartfelt resolve.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—When that time comes, will I truly be 
able to stay free from pressure...?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Hm, hm-hmm~♪ Debut time, debut time~♪
choice_data_list:
（……For now, I just need to focus on the 
race in front of me.）

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Knock knock)

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: "Vivlos. How are you feeling?"

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Mother
text_block_list.text:
Your Make Debut is coming up soon! 
Exciting, isn't it, Vivlos-chan?♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The ones who entered the waiting room were 
Vilbros's parents and Verxina.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Did you all come all this way? All the 
way to Kyoto?"

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Mother
text_block_list.text:
Of course I am~ It's Vivlos-chan's super, 
super important debut race, after all!

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Mother
text_block_list.text:
I even helped myself to some of 
Chevalier-chan's power while she was 
working hard at training, you know?

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Father
text_block_list.text:
"Vivlos, believe in yourself, and make 
sure you come back safe and sound!"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Ehh~~, I'm so happy! Thank you, Mom, 
Dad!"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Just a little while ago at the station, 
one of big sis's fans gave me some 
encouragement!♪"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ! I see...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Could you cheer me on too, Big Sis... 
please?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...Good luck, Vivlos. You only get one 
debut race in your entire life.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Go make a spectacular debut in true 
style, just like you always do!"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Yeah, thank you, Big Sis♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ...*stare*

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I want to hear you cheer for me, 
okay?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Yup, thanks! I'll go give it my all!
